contexts.text: A Hittite () = falsity.
Canaan begat Heth (). Heth = the exterior Knowledges of celestial things. Explained, Illustrated.

That Heth = exterior Knowledges without internal ones, is evident in Ezekiel... Your mother was a Hittite.... To loathe husbands and sons = to reject goods and truths; hence her mother is called a Hittite.
Heth also = the exterior Knowledges of celestial things in a good sense... The Knowledges of celestial things are those which regard love, thus life.
The Hittite, etc. () = persuasions of falsity.
Under Ephron, see this reference. AC 2941. AC 3257.
The sons of Heth () = those with whom is a new Spiritual Church.
(References to passages in the Word where the Hittites are mentioned.) Many of them were of the Ancient Church... All of that Church acknowledged charity as the chief thing...

The Hittites were among the better ones in Canaan; (for) Abraham dwelt among them, and afterwards Isaac and Jacob, and were also buried with them; and they behaved themselves with piety and modesty towards Abraham... Hence by them, as by an upright nation, is represented... the Spiritual Church, or the truth of the Church. But... as with the rest of the Ancient Church, in course of time they fell away from charity... and hence by them is afterwards signified what is false of the Church... That still the Hittites were among the more honoured, is evident from Hittites being with David, as Abimelech (), and Uriah... whose wife was Bathsheba, by whom David had Solomon.
Heth = exterior Knowledges which regard life, which are the external truths of the Spiritual Church.
It does not here treat of any (new) Church with the sons of Heth, but in general of the resuscitation of the Spiritual Church... The sons of Heth are only those who represent...
The sons of Heth answered Abraham () = a reciprocal state with those of the new (Spiritual) Church.
To the people of the Land, the sons of Heth () = by those who are of the Spiritual Church.
The sons of Heth = the same (that is, those with whom the good and truth of faith can be received) in so far as they were of the city of Ephron, and in so far as they were his people. AC 2940.
To the eyes of the sons of Heth () = to the understanding of those who are of the new Spiritual Church.

From the sons of Heth () = that it was of the gentiles... The sons of Heth were not those with whom the Church was established, but are those by whom that Church is represented... That the sons of Heth = a new Church... of the Gentiles. Shown and Explained.

(Esau) took a woman, Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite () = the adjunction of natural truth from another source than the real one... For the Hittites were among the upright nations in Canaan... and by them is there represented a Spiritual Church among the gentiles; and as this Church is not in truth from the Word, by the same people is signified truth not from what is really genuine... AC 3620:end.

I loathe my life on account of the daughters of Heth () = the adjunction of natural truth from another source... The daughters of Heth = affections of truth from what is not genuine; here, of natural truth, because it is said in relation to Jacob... That Heth, or Hittite = truth from what is not genuine. Reference. AC 3621. AC 3686. AC 3688.

The Hittites were of the Church of the gentiles in Canaan, and were not so much in falsity and evil as the other nations there... Hence by the Hittites is represented the Lord's Spiritual Church with the gentiles...

The remains of a Church from Ancient time still existed in Canaan, especially with those called Hittites, and Hivites: hence it is that by these nations are represented the truths which have been of the Church.
The remains of the Most Ancient Church... were still in Canaan, especially with those called Hittites, and Hivites.
As those remains existed with the Hittites and Hivites, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, with their wives, obtained a place of burial among the Hittites... and Joseph among the Hivites ().
Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite () = the quality which was from the Ancient Church.
Ephron the Hittite () = those with whom the truth and good of faith can be received, thus those with whom what is obscure of faith can become clear.

The purchase of the field and of the cave in it was from the sons of Heth () = the redemption of those who receive truth, and, through truth, good... The sons of Heth = the Spiritual Church which was from the Ancient one, (and therefore) they = hose who receive truth, and through truth good...
Ephron the Hittite = those who receive the good of faith, and suffer themselves to be regenerated; and the sons of Heth = the Spiritual Church.
Unto the place of the Canaanite and the Hittite () = the region occupied by evils from falsities... The Hittites = the falsities from which are evils. Explained. AC 6859:end. AC 8054, Explained.
He shall bring thee to the Amorite, and the Hittite, etc. () = when the Lord has protected against the evils and falsities which infest the Church, and has removed them.

It shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite from before thee () = the flight of falsities from evils... (AE 650:59.) The Hivite = falsity from lighter evil; the Canaanite, falsity from more grievous evil; and the Hittite, falsity from the most grievous evil.
I drive out from thy faces the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite () = the removal then of evils and the derivative falsities.
Ships from the coast of the Hittites (.) = the Knowledges of truth and good which had been possessed by those of the Ancient Church.
